meta.name: card-theater
meta.description: 生成侧边栏叙事 + 3D 卡片轮播的演示动画 HTML 页面。支持滚动翻页、Coverflow 3D、Focus 展开等多种交互模式，内置模式切换（如传输/隧道）、荧光笔高亮、水印图标等效果。适合协议流程演示、产品特性展示、分步讲解场景。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把讲解步骤做成带3D翻页的网页演示
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把枯燥的流程说明变成直观的互动网页
copy.tagline_en: Turn step-by-step explanations into 3D flip-page web demos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn boring process guides into interactive web pages

howto.what: 当你要演示流程或概念时，Claude 会生成一个单文件 HTML 演示页：左侧叙事栏显示标题和解说，右侧 3D 卡片轮播展示步骤，支持键盘、滚轮和点击切换，并可加入模式切换、荧光笔高亮等效果。
howto.when: 当你说出“卡片演示”“协议流程演示”等词，或要求做分步讲解、3D 卡片展示时触发。

say.text: 生成一个 5 张卡片的 HTTPS 握手流程演示，带高亮
做一个渐进式讲解的卡片轮播，先标题后详情
say.note: 会选用 coverflow-focus 模板展开详情。

howto.what_en: When you ask to present a process or concept, Claude generates a single-file HTML demo: a left narrative panel shows the title and explanation, while a right 3D card carousel displays steps. Keyboard, wheel, and click navigation are supported, with optional mode switching and highlighter effects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'card demo' or 'protocol flow demo', or ask for step-by-step explanations / 3D card showcases.

say_en.text: Make a coverflow-classic demo comparing IPsec transport and tunnel modes.
say_en.note: Produces a 3D card demo with mode switching.

say_en.text: Generate a 5-card HTTPS handshake demo with highlights.
say_en.note: Uses coverflow-classic with wheel and keyboard navigation.

say_en.text: Build a progressive card carousel with titles then details.
say_en.note: Uses the coverflow-focus template to expand details.
